description: Explicit, reviewable adjustments to how names in event evidence are resolved to dataset entities. They resolve a NAME to an entity; they do not assert any relationship between entities.

GOOGL.reason: Cloud business of Google LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.
Google LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.

AMZN.reason: Abbreviation of Amazon Web Services, part of Amazon.com, Inc.

META.reason: Short name of Meta Platforms, Inc.

rtx.reason: RTX is also NVIDIA's product brand (GeForce RTX, RTX Spark). The defence company RTX Corporation is resolved only when its legal form follows.

denied_aliases.samsung: Not an alias: 'Samsung' is a group of distinct listed companies (Samsung Electronics, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, ...). Only 'Samsung Electronics' resolves to Samsung Electronics.
